slots.name: body
slots.description: Body slot uses a generic from `@template`; that tag must not appear on the slot in output.

slots.name: item
slots.description: `@enum` shares blocks with typedefs/slots in some codebases; it must not attach to the slot.

slots.name: row
slots.description: `@type` without a preceding `@event` is ignored for events and must not become a passthrough tag.
